name: Build-A-Bear Workshop
verdict: WAIT (DD 4/10) — zero edge at spot; entry band $25-26
dd_summary: NOT the FUTU licensing-top (the FY22 step-change was a real model overhaul: A-mall/tourist/experience + adult gifting) — but pre-tax income FLAT ~$67M for THREE years while revenue +13%; ALL EPS growth since FY24 is buyback (15.25M->12.6M sh). Q1 FY26: retail -5.1%, traffic DOWN/ticket up (the melt pattern), headline 'beat' entirely a ~$10.4M one-time IEEPA tariff-refund BBW itself broke out (honesty CLEAN — the masking was in the PR framing, market saw through it: 52wk low, 22.7% short). CEO architect Sharon Price John left Jun-11-26 — key-person risk MATERIALIZED at the worst moment. Commercial/partner engine real (178 units, ~60% GM, asset-light) but 7.3% of revenue — a decade from carrying the story. Per-store health NOT collapsing (NA $518/sqft rising) — the softness is top-of-funnel traffic.
market_implied: 7.7x prices continued flat-to-down earnings, NO severe melt, NO re-acceleration — peak-earnings largely IN the price; edge at 30.56 ~ 0
entry_band: 1.0% starter ~$25-26 (6.3x trough EPS, ~14% FCF yield, net-cash + buyback + 3.7% div floor); 2nd 0.5% ~$21; OR post-Q2 on traffic inflection + commercial >10% mix
cap_structure: CLEAN: net cash ~$26M, $40M revolver undrawn, no preferreds/warrants/converts; ~14% of shares retired in 3yrs; div $0.92 QUALIFIED; 2023 special was one-off
kill_triggers: buyback paused / revolver drawn for opex
decisive_question: Q1 traffic decline: structural (kids-TAM/birth-rate + B-mall-third decay) or cyclical (macro air-pocket + tough comps)? Per-sqft RISING while traffic falls = unresolvable from one quarter; Q2 (~Aug-28 est, UNCONFIRMED) is the referee — and near-term skew is NEGATIVE (no refund to flatter, first print under the new CEO).
tax_fit: good SHAPE wrong PRICE: -50% drawdown vol + 22.7%-short squeeze convexity = recoverable-downside class; qualified div = modest drag; cleanly harvestable if it falls post-entry
venue_screen_feedback: the screen's CAUSAL claim REFUTED (cheapness = plateau + CEO exit + tariff + shorts, NOT mall-guilt mispricing); venue QUALITY corroborated as DOWNSIDE SUPPORT (A-mall/tourist real estate + rising per-sqft = not a melting-anchor liquidation; the floor is higher than the multiple implies)

edge_explainer.market_believes: A COVID-era toy fad rolling over: traffic falling, earnings flat three years, the turnaround CEO just left, tariffs bite plush — 52-week low and 22.7% of the float short.
edge_explainer.we_believe: Mostly the same facts, differently weighted: the earnings step-change was a real model overhaul (not one licensing hit), the balance sheet is net-cash returning ~90% of FCF, per-store productivity is RISING, and a genuine asset-light partner engine is growing 40 units/yr — but it's 7% of revenue and the core IS decelerating.
edge_explainer.why_we_might_have_edge: None at spot — priced almost exactly at our probability-weighted value. The prepared edge is the ENTRY PLAN: at $25-26 the trough math (6.3x, 14% FCF yield, cash floor) pays us to make the structural-vs-cyclical call; everyone else must decide at $31.
edge_explainer.why_it_might_be_priced_in: It is — that's the verdict. The market has correctly identified the plateau.
edge_explainer.what_resolves_it: Q2 (~late Aug): traffic direction ex-refund + the new CEO's first print; then the holiday quarters.
edge_explainer.mechanism_falsifier: Two consecutive quarters of comps worse than -7% = structural confirmation = value trap at any multiple — walk permanently.
